id.description: id of the new Collection Configuration

name.description: name of the new Collection Configuration

description.description: description of the new Collection Configuration

template.description: template of the new Collection Configuration

category.description: Optional category of the new Collection Configuration

targets.description: Array of targets specified in this Collection Configuration

hasInputs.description: whether any input paths are specified within any of the Targets or Computers in this Collection Configuration

tasks.description: Array of tasks specified in this Collection Configuration

custodianId.description: id of the Custodian this target belongs to

computerName.description: name of the Computer this target belongs to

computerGUID.description: GUID of the Computer this target belongs to

Inputs.description: array of inputs in the target

location.description: full path or AutoDetect setting for the source

exclusion.description: excluded subfolders in the location (only for Path type)

parentConfigId.description: Optional, id of the parent Collection Configuration of the new task to be copied. If omitted, the task is created from given params.

taskNum.description: Optional, id of the task to be copied (within the parent conf specified above).  Required if parentConfigId is specified.

taskType.description: Type of task\: one of `Collect`, `Relocate`, `Deploy`, or `Launch` (currently only `Collect` and `Relocate` are supported).  NOTE\: If copying an Existing task, the `taskType` cannot be changed in the new task.

label.description:
Optional, user-defined label for this job.

Can be used as search criteria for jobs.
